bio.text: Elinor "Ellie" Gilbreath, a Democrat, won the May 2026 Democratic primary for Idaho's 2nd Congressional District, according to KIVI-TV.

In an Idaho Capital Sun candidate survey, Ellie Gilbreath listed her hometown as Ketchum, Idaho, her age as 63, her professional background as lawyer, mediator and conflict resolution and strategy expert, and her time in Idaho as 23 years.
